answer: Each identity locks 70 credits for one basalt plot on the vine registry, endorsed by five neighbors, each key-signed. At dawn a beacon names a tenth of the plots; a named holder shows five within one hour, and auditors replay the vine registry; a reused endorser burns both bonds. First filing 38, the kth 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool, one honest agent pays 38. Rented neighbors fail: one cannot endorse two plots.
